newsitem.title: USA: Iowa corn crop 63 percent mature, safe from frost.
newsitem.headline: Iowa corn crop 63 percent mature, safe from frost.

text.p: Iowa's corn crop was 63 percent mature and safe from frost as of Sunday, according to the Iowa Agricultural Statistics Service.
The maturity pace was up from 40 percent the previous week but well behind the 90 percent of a year ago and 78 percent average.
Corn conditions were one percent very poor, three percent poor, 20 percent fair, 56 percent good and 20 percent excellent.
Corn was three percent harvested, up from two percent a week ago and below the nine percent average.
Sixty-six percent of the soybean crop was dropping leaves, up from 34 percent a week ago, down from 82 percent a year ago and well behind the 79 percent average pace.
One percent of the state's soybean crop was harvested, up from none a week ago, down from 10 percent a year ago and below the 15 percent average pace.
Soybean conditions were one percent very poor, five percent poor, 27 percent fair, 52 percent good and 15 percent excellent.
